grading: Freeze rubrics before runs; grade each criterion 0 absent/incorrect, 1 partial, 2 complete with evidence. Report per-case results and failures, not only totals.
comparison: Run bare model and full skill on identical fixtures and prompts; repeat at least three times. No scores inferred from author review or a single trial.
checks: Use actionlint in a staged repository, tool configuration checks and disposable builds. Exercise failing command propagation, semantic tag rejection, fork permissions and release needs conditions. Static checks do not prove hosted enforcement.
export: Any external evaluation must disclose and obtain applicable authorization for the exact candidate payload. Do not export repository secrets or unrelated files.
